difficultyRationale: Checks the command-line form for launching a main class from a named module on a module path.
prompt: Which command form launches main class `p.Main` from named module `com.example.app` when the module is available under `mods`?
explanation: The `java` launcher uses `--module-path` (or `-p`) to locate modules and `--module module[/mainclass]` (or `-m`) to name the module and optionally its main class.

options.explanation: This names both the module path and the module/main-class pair.
`--requires` is not a java launcher option for selecting a module this way.
Exports is a module declaration/access concept, not the normal launch syntax.
The launcher does not launch a named module by passing its module-info source file.
